title: Nine Pounds in 1781
subtitle: 家族与祖先 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家族与祖先（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：家族与祖先（历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：ancestor　|　正文 365 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ancestor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my grandmother found one ① ancestor in a book, a man who had been fined nine pounds in 1781 for something nobody wrote down, and she said that was the only honest entry in the whole parish. A ② distant ancestor of hers, meaning nine generations back, had been a clockmaker, and she said a trade lasts longer in a family than a name does; an ancestor, she said, is the only person you are related to without ever meeting.

The ③ ancestor of the sheep on the hill, meaning the first of the breed, had been brought in 1841 by a man with one idea. Every ④ ancestor house in the valley had the same door, and my grandfather said a door is the only part of a house that outlives the family; an ancestor, he said, is a man who decided something you still have to live with.

Her ⑤ ancestors, all nine of the ones she could name, had lived within seven miles of the same church, and she said that was either loyalty or a failure of imagination. She could ⑥ trace our ancestors back to 1781 and no further, and she said a line that stops is more interesting than a line that does not; an ancestor, she said, is a person whose choices you are still paying for.

There was ⑦ no ancestor worship in our house, by which my grandmother meant no photographs, and she said the dead are better remembered by what they made than by how they looked. In 1979 she called the clockmaker ⑧ our ancestor in trade, meaning the first of us who made anything, and she said a family begins twice, once by blood and once by work; every ancestor, she said, is somebody who began something.

The ⑨ ancestor I would claim, if I claimed one, is not the clockmaker or the man with the sheep but the one who was fined nine pounds in 1781 for something nobody wrote down. An ⑩ ancestor, she told me in 1988, is the only person in a family who is allowed to be wrong for two hundred years, and no ancestor of ours has ever been allowed to be wrong at all.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （某一行的）前辈；先驱
D. （作定语）祖传的；祖先留下的
E. 固定搭配：one's ancestors 某人的祖先们
F. 固定搭配：a distant ancestor 远祖
G. 固定搭配：trace one's ancestors 追溯祖先
H. 固定搭配：ancestor worship 祖先崇拜

items.q: The ancestor of the sheep on the hill
Every ancestor house in the valley
Her ancestors, all nine of the ones
There was no ancestor worship in our house
An ancestor, she told me in 1988

answers.why: ancestor 意为“祖先”，1967 年祖母在一本书里找到一位祖先：1781 年他因一件无人记录的事被罚九英镑。
a distant ancestor 意为“远祖”，她的一位远祖往上九代，是个钟表匠。
ancestor 意为“（物种的）原种、先祖”，山上那些羊的先祖是 1841 年由一个只有一个念头的人带进来的。
ancestor 作定语，意为“祖传的、祖先留下的”，山谷里每一座祖上传下来的房子都装着同样的门。
one's ancestors 意为“某人的祖先们”，她能叫出名字的九位祖先都住在距同一座教堂七英里之内。
trace one's ancestors 意为“追溯祖先”，她能把我们的祖先追溯到 1781 年，再往前就不行了。
ancestor worship 意为“祖先崇拜”，我们家没有祖先崇拜——她指的是屋里没有照片。
ancestor 意为“前辈、先驱”，1979 年她称那位钟表匠是我们“手艺上的前辈”。
ancestor 意为“祖先”，我要认的祖先不是钟表匠，也不是养羊的那个人。
ancestor 意为“祖先”，她说祖先是家族里唯一被允许错了两百年的人。
